snippet.title: Conrad Stevenson's Paranormal P.I. Trailer
snippet.description:
I made this first-person single player ghost hunting simulation game, trying to take an authentic approach at investigating ghosts. Use essential paranormal tools to help your community alleviate their concerns and put their minds at ease.

Play: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1872860/Conrad_Stevensons_Paranormal_PI/
